description: Local MCP server that lets Claude Code and other MCP clients control OTerminal: stage and commit via the source control panel, open URLs in the built-in browser, focus editors, and run terminal commands. Commits are always authored by the local git user.
untrusted.description: The MCP server exposes editor, source control, and terminal control to local clients. It is disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.enabled: Run the local MCP server on startup.
config.host: Loopback address to bind to. Keep on 127.0.0.1 unless you understand the implications.
config.port: TCP port for the MCP HTTP+SSE server, the same every time so client configs keep working. If another OTerminal window already has it, a window uses a free port instead and points its own terminals at it. 0 = sticky port: pick a free port the first time, then reuse it.
config.projectConfig: Keep the "oterminal" server in each opened repository's .mcp.json (Claude Code's project MCP config) up to date. The entry holds neither the address nor the token: inside OTerminal it uses the window's own server, elsewhere the default port with a token file in your home folder that only you can read. So it works from any terminal and is safe to commit.
config.projectConfig.update: Update the entry in repositories whose .mcp.json already has it.
config.projectConfig.create: Also add .mcp.json with the entry to git repositories that don't have one.
config.allowedOrigins: Additional HTTP Origin values to accept on the SSE endpoint. Loopback origins are always allowed.
cmd.copyConfig: Copy Claude Code MCP Config to Clipboard
